decisions.reason: A cheap accessory that complements the trailer range and ties up almost no resources, so slack carries it, though its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
The box trailer line is core business and likely met aspirations during the strong pandemic-era demand for trailers, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
The low-bed series fits the firm's production know-how and serves steady professional and private hauling demand, with no evidence of results below aspiration despite rising material costs.
The high-cover series broadens the core range at modest extra cost, so management retains it while watching for overlap with the box trailers as steel and supply costs squeeze margins.
